name: avunu/gutenberg-downgrade-test-tools
description: Test runners and static analysers for gutenberg-downgrade. Deliberately separate from the plugin's own composer.json: composition-c4's fetchComposerDeps clones lock.packages ++ lock.packages-dev at eval time with allRefs=true, so anything added to the root manifest is paid for on every `nix build .#zip`. phpstan and php-codesniffer are locked here too, not in the root.
